In The Supreme Court Of India

 (Arising out of Slp (C) No.7421 of 2019)
 The State Of Haryana & Anr. Appellant(S)
 Versus
 Radhey Shyam & Ors. Respondent(S)

WITH  CIVIL APPEAL NO. OF 2024  (Arising out of SLP (C) NO.7427 of 2019)
 THE STATE OF HARYANA & ANR. APPELLANT(S)

VERSUS  M/S. MITTAL WOOLEN & COTTON MILLS RESPONDENT(S)
 O R D E R 1.
Leave granted.

2. The impugned orders dated 30-10-2017 passed by the High Court of Punjab and Haryana at Chandigarh, whereby the Civil Writ Petition Nos.4839 and 8038 of 2015 filed by the respective respondents  herein were allowed, are under challenge before this Court.

entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Civil Writ Petition Nos.4839 and 8038 of 2015
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text:
3. None has entered appearance for the respondents in both the appeals, though duly served.
4.

Having heard the learned A.A.G. for the appellants and carefully perusing the material placed on record, it appears that the High Court had declared the acquisition proceedings in question as lapsed in view of Section 24(2) of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text:
However, in view of the later decision in the case of Indore Development Authority vs. Manoharlal And Ors. Etc. Reported in (2020) 8 SCC The State Of Haryana vs Radhey Shyam on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/139549120/
1 129, the matters are required to be remitted to the High Court for fresh consideration.

entities.text: Indore Development Authority vs. Manoharlal And Ors. Etc. Reported in (2020) 8 SCC The State Of Haryana vs Radhey Shyam on 15 February, 2024 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 5. In that view of the matter, the impugned orders passed by the High Court are set aside and the matters are remitted to the High Court for fresh consideration in the light of the Judgment in the case of Indore Development Authority (supra).
6. It is clarified that all legal contentions are kept open to be raised by both the parties, as may be permissible.
7. The appeals stand allowed in above-terms.
8. Pending applications, if any, also stand disposed of.
